office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Denice Gagner is the only candidate for this position; the pamphlet names no incumbent, so the seat appears to be open.

candidates.summary: Judge pro tem with prior work as a victim advocate, prosecutor, and criminal defense attorney, running for a seat for which the pamphlet names no incumbent.
highlights: Judge pro tem in King County District Court and municipal courts [S1]
Reports prior work as a victim advocate, prosecutor, and criminal defense attorney [S1]
Self-reports "Exceptionally Well Qualified" ratings from 7 bar associations [S1]
